en.headline: Customs raids seven illicit cigarette retail points, arrests 10
en.dek: Officers posing as customers seized about 128,000 sticks worth HK$580,000 during a three-day territory-wide operation targeting newsstands and stalls.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it had dismantled seven retail points selling suspected illicit cigarettes during a three-day enforcement operation that began on 3 November.

Officers disguised as customers conducted test purchases at newsstands, temporary stalls and one shop across Yau Ma Tei, Sham Shui Po, Tsuen Wan, Shau Kei Wan, Tuen Mun and Kwun Tong. They arrested five men and five women aged 43 to 90, all staff or owners of the outlets.

The department seized about 128,000 sticks of suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes with an estimated market value of HK$580,000 and a duty potential of about HK$420,000. Some outlets were also found selling low-priced cigarettes that resembled tax-paid packs, commonly known as white-brand cigarettes.

Customs said the operation followed reports of retail points selling cigarettes below the statutory duty level. It reiterated that dealing in, possessing, selling or buying illicit cigarettes is an offence under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, carrying a maximum penalty of a HK$2 million fine and seven years' imprisonment. The department said patrols and enforcement would continue.

zh.headline: 海關搗破七個私煙零售點 拘捕十人
zh.dek: 關員喬裝顧客三日全港行動，檢獲約12.8萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，市值約58萬元。
body: 香港海關表示，自11月3日起一連三日在全港多區採取執法行動，成功搗破七個售賣懷疑私煙的零售點。
關員喬裝顧客在油麻地、深水埗、荃灣、筲箕灣、屯門及觀塘的報檔、臨時攤檔及一間士多進行突擊試買，拘捕五男五女，年齡介乎43至90歲，全為涉案店舖職員或東主。
行動中檢獲約12.8萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，估計市值約58萬元，應課稅值約42萬元。部分零售點亦以低價出售包裝與已完稅香煙相似的「白牌煙」。
海關指，是次行動因應早前有報道指市面有零售點以低於法定稅款價格出售香煙。根據《應課稅品條例》，處理、管有、售賣或購買未完稅香煙均屬違法，最高刑罰為罰款200萬元及監禁七年。海關表示會繼續加強巡查及執法。
